create_segmented_pdf_page: create a SegmentedPdfPage with text cells, bitmap resources, and PDF geometry for segmented PDF processing
export_segmented_pdf_page_to_json: export a SegmentedPdfPage to a JSON file with indentation and serialization options
load_segmented_pdf_page_from_json: load a SegmentedPdfPage from a JSON file path and return the instantiated object
crop_text_from_segmented_page: crop text from a SegmentedPdfPage within a bounding box using specified cell unit type
render_segmented_pdf_page_as_image: render a SegmentedPdfPage as a PIL image with optional cell bounding boxes, text, lines, and bitmap resources
export_parsed_pdf_document_to_json: export a ParsedPdfDocument with pages, metadata, and table of contents to a JSON file
load_parsed_pdf_document_from_json: load a ParsedPdfDocument from a JSON file path and return the instantiated object
iterate_parsed_pdf_document_pages: iterate through all pages in a ParsedPdfDocument yielding page number and page tuples
